onboarding.howToSetupTtsOn: How to set up TTS on
onboarding.welcomeBody: Corpán is an open-source app from a tiny team, not a big company. We care deeply about language and education and we are still early, so you may see rough edges or missing features and languages. If something does not work, please tell us on GitHub or by email. Your feedback helps us ship frequent updates and make language learning better for everyone.
onboarding.linkCopied: Link copied. Open in your browser:

voiceGuide.title: Unlock your device's best voices
voiceGuide.intro: Your device has rich, natural voices built in — free, and far better than the default. The maker just leaves them switched off. Let's turn them on; it only takes a few taps:
voiceGuide.step2: Go to Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices.
voiceGuide.step4: Download a Premium or Enhanced voice.
voiceGuide.step5: Come back to Corpán — it appears here automatically.
voiceGuide.macStep3: Under System Voice, open Manage Voices.
voiceGuide.macStep4: Download a Premium or Enhanced voice for your language.
voiceGuide.macStep5: Come back to Corpán — it appears here automatically.

onboarding.welcomeFollowUp: Thanks for joining—see you in the community!
onboarding.noVoicesHint: Install voices to enable this language.
onboarding.appleNoVoiceTitle: Apple doesn't ship a {{lang}} voice yet
onboarding.appleNoVoiceBody: A quick note to Apple's accessibility team helps make the case. {{lang}} works natively on Android in the meantime.
onboarding.languageOrderTipBody: The bottom language in the list is the app's UI language. To change the UI language, drag a different language to the bottom.
onboarding.ttsOsTipAndroid: Best results: use Google text-to-speech. Samsung TTS does not work in Corpán.
onboarding.ttsOsTipIOS: Your device has free Premium voices built in — Apple just leaves them off. Switch them on: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices → your language, then tap the download icon for a Premium or Enhanced voice. Come back and it appears here automatically. (Apple doesn't cover every language yet.)
onboarding.ttsOsTipMac: Your Mac has free Premium voices built in — Apple just leaves them off. Switch them on: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices, then download a Premium or Enhanced voice. Come back and it appears here automatically. (Apple doesn't cover every language yet.)
onboarding.ttsOsTipWindows: In Settings, add/install speech voices, then return here.
onboarding.ttsOsTipOther: In your device settings, add/install text-to-speech voices, then return here.
